UI FANOUT PASS 1 — HUD / VISUAL HIERARCHY. Audit the Onslaught source reconstruction as a game UI designer and frontend engineer. Improve the in-game HUD and presentation so it feels intentional, compact, readable, and fitting for a dark survival zombie shooter rather than a generic web demo. Focus on hierarchy for health, ammo, score/wave, prompts, start/game-over states, spacing, typography, contrast, subtle depth, and preserving maximum view of the 3D action. Respect the existing art direction and mechanics; do not redesign gameplay. Prefer CSS/DOM presentation changes and minimal JS only when required. Mobile must remain first-class, including safe areas and landscape. Avoid oversized panels or visual clutter. Return a coherent unified diff within the allowlisted source-reconstruction scope, plus exact tests the lead should run. Do not claim tests were run.
